# MRP Rule 1 - The round only ends at the Lobby screen
Unlike on low roleplay (LRP) servers, the round is [italic]only[/italic] considered over once the game has returned to the Lobby screen. This means that all roleplay rules and MRP rules are still in effect, even after the end-of-round popup.
## Examples Acceptable: - After reaching Central Command, Security makes an effort to arrest and detain any known criminals who had escaped their custody aboard the emergency shuttle. - After reaching Central Command, an antagonist with an objective to steal the Chief Medical Officer's hypospray attacks the Chief Medical Officer in order to rob them.
Prohibited: - After reaching Central Command, Security arrests an antagonist who they had no prior suspicion of because they're listed as an antagonist in the end-of-round popup. - After reaching Central Command, a syndicate agent kills the Chief Medical Officer despite having no objectives related to doing so. - After reaching Central Command, a non-antagonist passenger beats an engineer to death with a toolbox for having annoyed them earlier in the shift. - After reaching Central Command, a silicon decides to start ignoring their lawset entirely. - After missing the emergency shuttle and being marooned on the station, a non-antagonist security officer begins shooting everyone else who was marooned out of boredom.
